description: Discover, validate, test, review-register and run isolated declarative extensions with fixed argv, no shell, timeouts, dry-run, path containment, a lockfile gate and disable/remove/reload. The pipeline is tested; OS-level sandboxing and network enforcement are not claimed.
requires: write access to the extension root for the lockfile and run state
checks: extension root is extensions/ or out of checkout, never a core directory
manifest schema, apiVersion, semantic version and capability id validate
entrypoint argv is an explicit list, never a shell string
entrypoint and declared read/write paths resolve inside the extension directory
every manifest declares a negative test and extension test fails when it unexpectedly succeeds
run refuses an unregistered, disabled or changed extension
dry-run executes nothing and writes no lockfile
register --accept hashes the tree and writes gypsy.lock.json atomically
disable/reload/remove are explicit, reversible or confirmed paths
